column1: # telemetry-off targets. Each start mechanism checked against the rootfs of
# Tab-separated: name  group  stub  binary  upstart-job  hub-service
#   stub         exit  = bind-mount an "exit 0" stub over binary
#                sleep = bind-mount a stub that sleeps forever (respawn jobs
#                Only used for upstart jobs. Never stub a binary that ls-hubd
#                launches on demand: the hub then waits LaunchTimeout (300 s,
#                /etc/luna-service2/ls-hubd.conf) for it to register and every
#   binary       the executable (used for the stub and to find running copies,
#   hub-service  ls-hubd on-demand service name ("-" = none). Every copy of
#                <name>.service in the three service dirs gets an empty file
#                bind-mounted over it, then ls-hubd is sent SIGHUP to rescan.
#                Calls then fail with "Service does not exist" in ~10 ms.
# Groups are enabled by TARGET_GROUPS in telemetry-off.conf.
